_doc: Canonical arch-id / SKU alias map (Q9). The canonical architecture identity is the bare sm_XX token; device-tier SKUs disambiguate cards that share a compute capability. Build-only tokens (sm_90a, sm_120a, sm_120f, sm_100a) normalise to their deploy family here but are NOT valid deploy arch_ids — see build_arch_families.json and Q5.
_rejected_doc: These are non-local server/workstation cards. They share the sm_120 (GB202) or sm_100 (B200) build family with the local parts but have DIFFERENT hardware facts (L2 size, SM count, L1 geometry). Resolving them as a local deploy arch_id would silently return 5060-laptop values, so the loader rejects them until a dedicated SKU card is captured. This mirrors preflight_manifest.REJECTED_SM120_NAME_SUBSTRINGS.
